text:
alex-support: FYI — OrchidBank hitting envelope decryption failures in staging right after they rotated their Azure Key Vault CMK. Customer says rewrap job errored with 403 during unwrap. Can we triage?

deploy-bot: rotation-job orchidbank-staging rewrap failed: UnwrapKeyFailed (403) at 2026-03-18T15:04:12Z

maria-security: @alex-support tagging in. Most likely RBAC/permissions mismatch on the service principal the rewrap job uses. Key rotation created a new key version; the SP might not have `unwrap` rights on the new version (or it was using an explicit versioned key id). Need to confirm both RBAC and diagnostic logs.

ben-engr-plat: Steps to debug (quick):
1) Verify assigned roles at the vault scope: `az role assignment list --assignee <sp-id> --scope /subscriptions/<sub>/resourceGroups/<rg>/providers/Microsoft.KeyVault/vaults/<kv-name>`
2) Check key versions: `az keyvault key list-versions --vault-name <kv-name> -n <key-name>`
3) Inspect the key resource: `az keyvault key show --id <key-id>`
4) Confirm diagnostic settings: `az monitor diagnostic-settings list --resource <kv-resource-id>`

sam-support: Customer notes they used a tenant SP that previously had a custom role labelled "Key Management Key Operator". That role had `Microsoft.KeyVault/keys/wrap/action` and `.../get`, but maybe it missed `unwrap`. Also they rotate keys by importing a new version (BYOK) from their HSM vendor, so the key *id* changed.

maria-security: Important checklist items to ask the customer:
- Are they referencing a key name only or a specific version in their rewrap job? (If versioned, job must be updated on rotation.)
- Does the SP have `Microsoft.KeyVault/keys/unwrap/action` and `.../wrap/action` at vault scope?
- Were diagnostic settings enabled before rotation (to capture `Unwrap` events)? If yes, send the activity logs.

ben-engr-plat: Quick mitigation we can recommend: temporarily grant the SP `Key Vault Crypto User` role at vault scope (or a custom role that includes `Microsoft.KeyVault/keys/unwrap/action`) then re-run rewrap. If that fixes it, we narrow down exact missing permission and then revert to least privilege.

alex-support: Can someone draft a short onboarding checklist snippet we can add to the BYOK onboarding doc so future customers don't hit this? I want exact CLI commands + minimal RBAC matrix.

maria-security: I'll draft it. Proposed content (will paste to docs PR):
```
Required permissions for rewrap flow:
- Microsoft.KeyVault/keys/get
- Microsoft.KeyVault/keys/wrap/action
- Microsoft.KeyVault/keys/unwrap/action

Minimal az checks:
az role assignment list --assignee <sp-id> --scope /subscriptions/<sub>/resourceGroups/<rg>/providers/Microsoft.KeyVault/vaults/<kv>
az keyvault key list-versions --vault-name <kv> -n <keyname>
az monitor diagnostic-settings list --resource <kv-resource-id>
```
Also include note: if customer uses imported HSM-backed BYOK, same actions apply, but ensure the import completed and key state is `Enabled`.

ben-engr-plat: Also add an ops note: prefer non-versioned key references in rewrap scripts (call `GET /keys/<keyname>` to resolve latest version) or implement a rotation hook to update job config when a new version appears. Example: `LATEST_KEY_ID=$(az keyvault key list-versions --vault-name $KV -n $KEY --query '[0].kid' -o tsv)`

sam-support: Update — customer accepted temporary role grant, ran rewrap, job succeeded. They confirmed artifacts decrypted after rewrap. They want us to keep them on the checklist and update docs. Closing steps: add PR to docs, follow up with onboarding checklist for Security/Support devex. :white_check_mark:

alex-support: Thanks team. @maria-security @ben-engr-plat can you coordinate a quick PR today? I'll attach the customer's repro snippets to the ticket.

maria-security: On it. Will include a short troubleshooting section about missing diagnostic settings and how to enable them: `az monitor diagnostic-settings create --resource <kv> --storage-account <sa> --logs '[{"category":"AuditEvent","enabled":true}]'`

ben-engr-plat: I'll add the sample role JSON for a custom role with only unwrap/wrap/get.

sam-support: I'll update the support ticket and mark as resolved once docs PR merges. Thanks all.
